verdict.rationale: n8n documents a REST 'n8n API' (n8n-docs-16), but explicit probing for a machine-readable spec (openapi.json, swagger.json, etc.) at the docs site returned 404 for all candidate paths (n8n-probe-2), and no other evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger spec. The axis applies to an automation platform with a public API, but there's no evidence it ships a discoverable machine-readable spec.
